phase3_exact_reusable_contract: proposed global module/class + repo local rows/charts -> verify one global class identity, every localization, 2/infinity normalization, support/field/theorem hypotheses -> PASS typed package or FAIL_CLOSED layer
contract: repo local rows/charts -> bind one fixed global H1/Kummer module/class to immutable construction evidence -> execute its mathematical verifier -> bind every retained local row/chart to immutable localization evidence -> execute every localization verifier -> execute an independently source-derived required-place inventory verifier -> certify field/support/dyadic/real normalization -> bind Serre/Milne exactly to the Phase3 freeze and execute theorem-hypothesis verifiers -> execute the global adapter mathematical verifier -> only then emit PASS; otherwise FAIL_CLOSED at the first missing or mismatched obligation
hypotheses: one named global finite module/class over one fixed global field with immutable construction evidence
source-to-global construction mathematical verifier executes successfully at its exact committed blob/head
every retained local row/chart has immutable localization evidence and its mathematical verifier executes successfully
an independently verified required-place inventory exactly equals the localization place set
all required finite, dyadic and real places are explicitly accounted for
finite-support assumptions have immutable proof evidence and an executed verifier when invoked
Serre/Milne theorem locators and hypotheses match the Phase3 freeze
literature-hypothesis evidence is immutable and each hypothesis verifier executes successfully
the separately bound global adapter mathematical verifier executes successfully
applicability: repo branches attempting to upgrade local character/Kummer data to Hilbert reciprocity, Selmer conditions or global-duality theorem inputs
do_not_use_for: constructing a missing global H1/Kummer class from local compatibility
treating path strings, 40-character strings or boolean true flags as proof evidence
calling the Hilbert product formula a contradiction
turning local admissibility into a rational point
descending extension-field data without a descent proof
granting theorem, receiver, local-global obstruction or endpoint credit
stage36_seed_inputs: S36-PW05 only when an explicit 2-isogeny/Kummer class is separately source-bound

literature.title: A Course in Arithmetic
literature.conclusion_summary: Hilbert pairing, product formula and simultaneous global realizability/compatibility statements for fixed global squareclass data.
literature.exact_hypotheses_summary: fixed global field and fixed squareclass/quadratic-form data with all local Hilbert-symbol inputs normalized at the relevant finite, dyadic and real places
literature.conditional_assumptions: the repo rows must already be proved to be localizations/evaluations of one fixed global class system; the product formula alone is not an obstruction

literature.title: Arithmetic Duality Theorems
literature.conclusion_summary: Poitou-Tate global duality for a fixed finite global Galois module with its localization data.
literature.exact_hypotheses_summary: one fixed finite global Galois module over one fixed global field, with the required localization maps and local conditions entering Poitou-Tate duality
literature.conditional_assumptions: Poitou-Tate use is inactive until the repo supplies and verifies the genuine fixed global module/class and exact localizations

immutable_binding_requirements.blob_rule: claimed blob_sha must equal git rev-parse <exact_head>:<path>; a syntactically valid 40-hex string is never sufficient
immutable_binding_requirements.verifier_evidence_head_rule: each proof verifier and its evidence must be committed at the same exact_head

mathematical_verifier_protocol.invocation: python <bound verifier blob> --verify-evidence <bound immutable JSON evidence blob> --json

required_final_json.subject: must equal the package-bound subject
required_final_json.verifier_path: must equal the bound verifier path
required_final_json.verifier_blob_sha: must equal the Git-resolved verifier blob
required_final_json.evidence_path: must equal the bound evidence path
required_final_json.evidence_blob_sha: must equal the Git-resolved evidence blob
required_final_json.exact_head: must equal the bound verifier/evidence exact head

literature_binding_rule: PASS requires both Phase3-frozen entries (Serre Chapter III Theorems 2-4 and Milne Theorem I.4.10), exact title/theorem/canonical locator/DOI/hypothesis/conditional-assumption equality, plus immutable hypothesis evidence whose mathematical verifier executes successfully.
place_completeness_rule: required_places_complete=true is necessary but never sufficient: an independently verified immutable required-place inventory must exist and its exact place set must equal the localization set, with dyadic and real/archimedean places explicitly named.
self_check_semantics: --self-check validates contract/freeze/provenance machinery and adversarial fake-SHA rejection only; it emits SELF_CHECK_OK, never applicability PASS.
current_stage36_status_reason: Phase3 explicitly freezes the Stage36 chart-to-global-H1 adapter and dynamic-reservoir-to-global-localization system as missing. #1692 therefore registers the workflow but does not contain a Stage36 LIT-WF02 PASS package.
pass_semantics: PASS certifies that the repo has supplied immutable evidence for one global class/module, exact localizations and required-place completeness, that all bound method-specific mathematical verifiers executed successfully from the claimed Git blobs, and that literature theorem bindings/hypotheses match the Phase3 freeze. PASS still does not re-prove the literature theorem or grant receiver/local-global/endpoint credit.
fail_semantics: Any missing or mismatched Git object, unexecuted/failing evidence verifier, missing global object, localization, place, support proof, field binding, theorem-hypothesis evidence, literature-freeze mismatch or adapter mathematical verifier yields FAIL_CLOSED with the first missing obligation.
repo_adapter: The workflow verifies an already-implemented adapter through immutable evidence and executable mathematical verifiers. It does not construct DYNAMIC_RESERVOIR_ROWS_TO_GLOBAL_KUMMER_LOCALIZATION_SYSTEM or POINTWISE_CHART_TUPLE_TO_GLOBAL_KUMMER_OR_TORSOR_CLASS.
